column2: Welcome to Bus Sahayak, your voice-first bus booking assistant.
Bus Sahayak helps blind and visually impaired users book bus tickets using only their voice.
No complicated screens, just your voice. Tell us where you want to go.
Hold the screen to activate voice commands at any time.
Double tap on any button to select it.
Triple tap anywhere on the screen to return to the home screen.
Say a number to choose from a list of options.
Let us get you started with your first booking.
You can say search buses to find a ride.
You can say my tickets to view your bookings.
Your voice is the only controller you need.
Every screen has voice guidance to help you navigate.
Press and hold anywhere on the screen to hear what is on it.
Swipe right to move to the next element on the screen.
Swipe left to go back to the previous element.
Say go home to return to the main screen at any time.
Say go back to return to the previous screen.
Say read to hear the current screen options again.
Say confirm to proceed with your selection.
Say cancel to stop the current action.
Bus Sahayak supports both English and Hindi voice commands.
Your bookings are confirmed by a real person who will call you.
No online payment required. Pay when the manager calls you.
This app is designed specifically for accessibility.
All buttons have clear voice labels and descriptions.
High contrast colors make the screen easier to see.
Voice feedback is always available on every screen.
You can adjust the speech speed in settings.
Bus Sahayak works on both phones and tablets.
Thank you for choosing Bus Sahayak. Let us find your bus.
